ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ASHL) announced the commissioning of Phase-I, a 66.68 MW solar power project in Bikaner, Rajasthan, on September 12, 2026, with commercial operations slated for September 14, 2026. This represents a material positive impact, bringing a significant portion of its 300 MW pipeline online to generate future revenue and expand its operational capacity, with no red flags apparent.
